title: Quantum "Twin Peaks" or Path Integrals in the Future Light Cone
summary: By analogy with the Wiener measure on the Euclidean plane that is invariant under the group of rotations and quasi-invariant under the group of diffeomorphisms, we construct the path integrals measure that is invariant under the Lorentz group and quasi-invariant under the group of diffeomorphisms. The correspondence between the paths in the future cone of the Minkowskian plane and the paths in the coverings of the Euclidean plane is established.
